description: Rank courses in a state using published tee data: hardest uses highest slope, easiest uses lowest slope among public/municipal courses, and longest uses maximum yardage. Returns each course name, access type, measured value and canonical Stymie URL. Link each recommended course using its returned URL and identify the ranking metric. These are tee-data rankings, not quality ratings or current booking availability; disclose private access.
